intro: Theldurin the Lost sends you to the Undercity of Lordaeron with a sigil. Keeper Bel'dugur is to take you for one of the people Theldurin fled, and you are to ask the keeper for Yagyin's Digest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The tablet tells much. But not enough! Not nearly enough!

There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past. The... People I fled from... They keep this book in many places. And their most learned study it. It holds vast knowledge. Knowledge to protect us!
Go to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity of Lordaeron. Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them. Ask him for Yagin's Digest...and bring it to me!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, we have an eager adventurer, I see. Are you here to learn from my collection? Good!
But be warned: just as knowledge gives power to the strong...it will drive the weak mad.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Be discrete with your signs, adventurer. There are those who do not believe the righteousness of our pledge.
And there are those who would see us fail if they knew of us.
We must always be careful. And watchful. And patient.
